ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: According to reports, China will launch the world's first professional nighttime light remote sensing satellite "Luojia-1" 01 satellite at the end of 2017, and launch the "Luojia-1" 02 satellite in 2019. The "Luojia-1" 01 satellite carries a high-sensitivity nighttime light camera, whose precision will reach a ground resolution of 100 m; at night it can see all bridges with lights on over the Yangtze River, and obtain nighttime images with precision higher than that of current American satellites. As shown in Figure 4, suppose "Luojia-1" operates on a circular orbit with radius R, and after time t, turns through an angle θ. It is known that the gravitational constant is G. Which of the following statements is correct (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows that the Earth is located near the center of the dashed circular orbit, and the satellite moves around the Earth on a circular orbit whose radius is labeled R; R represents the distance from the Earth's center to the satellite's orbital position. The problem stem gives that the satellite turns through angle θ after time t, so its angular velocity is ω=θ/t. In circular motion, universal gravitation provides the centripetal force: GMm/R^2=mω^2R. Canceling the satellite mass m gives M=ω^2R^3/G. Substituting ω=θ/t, the Earth's mass can be obtained as M=θ^2R^3/(Gt^2).

method.method_draft: 从图中确认“珞珈一号”绕地球做圆轨道运动，轨道半径为 R；从题干读取 t 内转角为 θ。先由圆周运动比例关系求周期：转过 θ 用时 t，转过 2π 用时 T=2πt/θ。再使用圆轨道的开普勒第三定律形式 T^2=4π^2R^3/(GM)，整理得 M=4π^2R^3/(GT^2)。代入 T=2πt/θ，得到 M=θ^2R^3/(Gt^2)。
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示地球在圆形轨道中心附近，“珞珈一号”位于虚线圆周轨道上，地球中心到卫星的虚线半径标为 R，说明卫星绕地球做半径为 R 的圆周运动。题干给出经过时间 t 转过角度 θ。由匀速圆周运动的比例关系，转过 θ 用时 t，则转过 2π 用时为 T=2πt/θ。圆轨道满足 T^2=4π^2R^3/(GM)，整理得 M=4π^2R^3/(GT^2)。代入 T=2πt/θ，得到 M=4π^2R^3/[G(2πt/θ)^2]=θ^2R^3/(Gt^2)。
